ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: All swap fees are kept by the protocol treasury.

methodology.Fees: USDC paid to launch a token, the 0.1% fee on public USDC committed during a guarded opening, and USDC-side Uniswap v3 LP fees generated by permanently locked Souless launch positions and collected on-chain.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol-retained share of launch and collected LP fees, all guarded-opening fees, and any unallocated Launch Partner campaign remainder returned to the protocol by the LaunchPartnerPool. LP-fee revenue is the residual after creator, Community, actual active-partner, and active-referrer allocations.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol-retained share of launch and collected LP fees, all guarded-opening fees, and unallocated Launch Partner campaign remainder, sent or claimable by the Souless treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Launch fees allocated to narrative-protection holders and collected LP fees allocated on-chain to token creators, Community Mode stakers and InfoFi contributors, active Launch Partner slots, and active referrers. Community allocations use each credited epoch's stored staking share. Launch Partner revenue uses the partner amount actually allocated by LaunchPartnerPool rather than the gross campaign transfer.

Fees.Launch Fees: USDC charged when a token is launched. Protected exact-name-and-ticker duplicates can pay a higher launch fee while protection is active.
Fees.Guarded Opening Fees: The 0.1% fee deducted from public USDC commitments when a guarded launch finalizes.
Fees.LP Fees: USDC-side Uniswap v3 trading fees harvested from permanently locked Souless launch positions. These fees are also present in Uniswap v3 fee reporting on Arc.

Revenue.Fees to Protocol: The protocol-retained portion emitted when launch and LP fees are credited, plus 100% of guarded-opening fees and any Launch Partner campaign allocation not earned by active partner slots.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees to Protocol: The protocol-retained portion emitted when launch and LP fees are credited, plus 100% of guarded-opening fees and any Launch Partner campaign allocation not earned by active partner slots.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees to Narrative Protection Holders: The protected-duplicate launch-fee share credited to the holder of the protected narrative.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: The collected USDC LP-fee share credited to the launched token creator.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees to InfoFi Contributors: The InfoFi portion of a Community Mode LP-fee allocation, calculated as the complement of the credited epoch's stored on-chain staking share.
SupplySideRevenue.Fees to Launch Partners: The portion of the Launch Partner campaign allocation actually credited to active partner slots. Any unallocated campaign amount is protocol revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Fees to Referrers: The collected LP-fee share credited while a launch's referral allocation is active.

A reward coin's transfer fee, a token tax paid in the launched coin, is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of trading fees and of the swap fees earned by locked graduation liquidity (each coin's immutable protocolShareBps, 30% at launch), launch fees, the trade router's fee, and the buyback and treasury shares of bids.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All revenue. It is split between the $OUTBID buyback vault and operations; $OUTBID has not launched, so none of it has reached token holders yet.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's share of trading fees and of the locked position's swap fees, the creator's own tax, and the swap fees earned by third-party liquidity providers.

Fees.Trading Fees: The 1% trading fee on the reserve-asset leg of every curve buy and sell, plus any snipe tax (FeesCharged.fee).
Fees.Creator Tax: The creator's own tax on every curve trade, up to 10%, fixed at launch (FeesCharged.tax).
Fees.Token Swap Fees: The fee tier of a graduated coin's Uniswap V3 pool (1%) on every swap, measured on the quote-asset leg.
Fees.Token Launch Fees: The ETH fee paid to launch a coin, forwarded by the factory to the RevenueRouter.
Fees.Front Page Bid Fees: The buyback and treasury shares of every front-page bid, in USDG (BidSettled): 20% and 5% of a bid on a coin launched here, 80% and 20% of a bid on a coin launched on PONS, which buys none of it.
Fees.Trade Router Fees: The trade router's fee (0.05%) on every trade sent from outbidfun.lol, in what the trade paid or bought (FeeCharged).

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share (protocolShareBps, 30% at launch) of the swap fees the coin's locked graduation position earns.
Revenue.Front Page Bid Fees To Protocol: The buyback and treasury shares of every bid.
Revenue.Trade Router Fees To Protocol: The whole trade router fee, paid to the RevenueRouter.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of the trading fee: each coin's immutable protocolShareBps (30% at launch).
ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share (protocolShareBps, 30% at launch) of the swap fees the coin's locked graduation position earns.
ProtocolRevenue.Front Page Bid Fees To Protocol: The buyback and treasury shares of every bid.
ProtocolRevenue.Trade Router Fees To Protocol: The whole trade router fee, paid to the RevenueRouter.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: The creator's share of the trading fee (70% at launch), claimable from the FeeEscrow or paid to a reward coin's holders.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Creators: The creator's own tax, paid to the creator in full.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Creators: The creator's share (70% at launch) of the swap fees the coin's locked graduation position earns.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To LPs: Swap fees earned by third-party liquidity added to a graduated coin's pool.

SupplySideRevenue.Doppler Pool Swap Fees to Doppler: Doppler's 8.68% (its 5% protocol cut plus its 5% beneficiary seat).

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of trading fees plus the launch fees in full.

The buyback is funded out of the creator slice and buys the launch token, so it is a cost of funds rather than revenue the protocol keeps.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees on FAZE bonding curves and graduated pools, plus token launch and graduation fees. Settled fees are adjusted for opening and closing pending balances.
methodology.Revenue: Fees retained by FAZE: platform treasury allocations plus creator fees from FAZE own-token pools. Excludes other projects creator allocations and fees allocated to locked liquidity. Buybacks are a subsequent capital allocation, not additional revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator allocations for other launched tokens, including their own burners, plus fees allocated to locked liquidity. Pending allocations use the contracts live split at each boundary.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Retained revenue after reclassifying net fees paid to the FAZE buyback burner; includes FAZE own-pool creator fees not yet distributed. This is revenue attribution, not a treasury cash balance.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Native USDC fees paid by the hook to the designated FAZE buyback burner, less failed-payment recredits and actual keeper rewards. Recognized at funding rather than swap execution; excludes unrelated deposits and other tokens burners.

Fees.Curve Trading Fees: Actual fees charged in bonding-curve buy and sell events, in each launch quote asset.
Fees.Hook Trading Fees: Fees charged by the FAZE hook, recognized on accrual rather than when claimed; the pool LP fee is zero.
Fees.Token Launch Fees: Native USDC launch fee in force at the time of each launch, reconstructed from fee-setting events.
Fees.Graduation Fees: Quote-asset migration fee recorded on successful curve graduation.

Revenue.Fees Retained by FAZE: Gross fees less other-project creator allocations and locked-liquidity allocations; includes FAZE own-pool creator fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees to Creators: Fees allocated to creators of other tokens launched on FAZE, irrespective of whether they redirect them to their own burners.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees to Locked Liquidity: Trading fees allocated to compounding into locked positions, counted once at allocation.

ProtocolRevenue.FAZE Revenue After Buyback Funding: Total retained fee revenue less net fee-funded distributions to the FAZE burner. Funding can distribute prior-period earnings; negative periods are not clamped.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 0.70% creator share of every trade, and the 0.10% used to buy back and burn the traded coin itself (except $LOONG).

methodology.Fees: Two things, and they are different money, and only the first of them is paid by anyone: it is reported as the user fee as well. First, the fee a trader paid on a swap in a pool the plugin runs in, at the rate the plugin set for that swap; the plugin takes no share of that fee, so nothing of it is charged to the user on the protocol's behalf. Second, the arbitrage the plugin realised inside the pool and paid out, read from the ProfitDistributed event where a deployment settles through a distributor and from the donatedToLps leg of ProfitShared where the plugin pays the pool's liquidity providers directly.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of the captured arbitrage, taken from the distributor's own share config as it stood at the block of each capture. Nothing of the swap fee is the protocol's, and the captures donated straight to liquidity providers leave it nothing either.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of the captured arbitrage, taken from the distributor's own share config as it stood at the block of each capture. Nothing of the swap fee is the protocol's, and the captures donated straight to liquidity providers leave it nothing either.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The swap fee in full, which the pool's liquidity providers and its AMM earn, plus the part of every capture that the share config pays to the pool's beneficiaries.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The fee traders paid on the pools the plugin runs in, at the rate the plugin set.
Fees.MEV Rewards: Arbitrage captured by the plugin when a swap moves the pool away from the wider market, closed out in the same transaction.

Revenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: The protocol's weight in the distributor's share config, applied to each capture.

ProtocolRevenue.MEV Rewards To Protocol: The protocol's weight in the distributor's share config, applied to each capture.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: The swap fee, which the pool's liquidity providers and its AMM earn in full.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV Rewards To LPs: The rest of every capture, paid to the pool's beneficiaries.

Revenue.Protocol Fees To MOTO Buyback And Burn: Buyback and burn bucket of the Collector (1/7 of the protocol fee since launch), used to buy MOTO and burn it.
Revenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: Treasury bucket of the Collector (2/7 of the protocol fee since launch).
Revenue.Rakeback program: Rakeback bucket of the Collector (2/7 of the protocol fee since launch). Rakeback is a protocol-run program funded out of the protocol fee, so like token incentives it is spent from revenue, not a supply-side payment.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: Treasury bucket of the Collector (2/7 of the protocol fee since launch).
ProtocolRevenue.Rakeback program: Rakeback bucket of the Collector (2/7 of the protocol fee since launch). Rakeback is a protocol-run program funded out of the protocol fee, so like token incentives it is spent from revenue, not a supply-side payment.

HoldersRevenue.Protocol Fees To MOTO Stakers: MOTO stakers bucket of the Collector (2/7 of the protocol fee since launch).
HoldersRevenue.Protocol Fees To MOTO Buyback And Burn: Buyback and burn bucket of the Collector (1/7 of the protocol fee since launch), used to buy MOTO and burn it.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Pair swap fee kept by liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Creators: Creator fee accrued to the coin creator in the CreatorFeeVault.

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees - traders pay all of it; liquidity providers are not charged.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on a swap: the pool's swap fee from the Swap event (protocol fee included), plus what a Latch launch pool's guard takes itself - the creator tax, and on newer launch guards the guard's part of the trade fee - read from the guard's TaxTaken and FeeTaken events. Only Latch's own launch guards are read.
methodology.Revenue: What reaches the protocol, counted when the fee is taken: the protocol fee each Swap event carries; the protocol's share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under the pool's permanent LP lock split, only where the locks provably hold all of the pool's liquidity; and the protocol's share of the creator tax and guard trade fee under the split the guard stores for that pool. A split that cannot be read is never guessed: that amount is left out of Revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of Revenue. Latch has no token, so nothing is diverted to holders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees minus Revenue: swap fees earned by liquidity providers, and the shares of locked-liquidity fees, creator tax and guard trade fees that go to launch creators and integrators (and any guard-taken amount whose split could not be read).
methodology.Volume: Gross input of every swap on CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager, one leg per swap. Swaps in Latch's own test tokens (LTT1/LTT2 on Robinhood Chain) are excluded: they have no market and no price.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
Fees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
UserFees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
Revenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
Revenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Creators And In: Creator and integrator shares of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Creators And Integr: Creator and integrator shares of the guard-taken trade fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees, Split Not Read: Guard-taken trade fee whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Creators And Integrators: Creator and integrator shares of the creator tax.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax, Split Not Read: Creator tax whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.

methodology.Fees: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.
methodology.Revenue: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Aerodrome LP trading fees distributed to MAMO stakers via the multi-rewards contract.

Fees.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: Aerodrome LP fees distributed to MAMO stakers.

methodology.Fees: Integrator fee TRNCH adds to swaps and bridges made on TRNCH (0.5% on a single swap, 1% on a swap of a token from the TRNCH Heat ranking or on a basket of swaps, 1.5% on a basket built from the Heat ranking, 1% on bridges), paid to the TRNCH treasury Safe through LI.FI, KyberSwap, 0x and Uniswap. Router and DEX fees are excluded.
methodology.UserFees: Users pay the full TRNCH integrator fee.
methodology.Revenue: All integrator fees received by the TRNCH treasury Safe are kept by TRNCH.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All integrator fees go to the TRNCH treasury.

Fees.LI.FI Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on LI.FI swaps and bridges, credited to the TRNCH Safe by the LI.FI FeeCollector or sent to it by the LI.FI FeeForwarder.
Fees.KyberSwap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees paid to the TRNCH Safe in KyberSwap router transactions.
Fees.0x Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees paid to the TRNCH Safe in 0x AllowanceHolder transactions.
Fees.Uniswap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees paid to the TRNCH Safe in Uniswap Universal Router transactions.

UserFees.LI.FI Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on LI.FI swaps and bridges.
UserFees.KyberSwap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on KyberSwap swaps.
UserFees.Uniswap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on Uniswap swaps.

Revenue.Integrator Fees To Treasury: Integrator fees received by the TRNCH treasury Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator Fees To Treasury: Integrator fees received by the TRNCH treasury Safe.

methodology.Volume: Native coin paid on buys and received on sells on ADEXTO bonding curves, gross of fees. Trades by the ADEXTO team's own wallets are excluded.
methodology.Fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.
methodology.UserFees: All swap fees paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator leg paid to each market's creator, the reserve leg that stays in the market's curve, and the buyback leg that buys and burns the market's own token.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.

methodology.Fees: Fees Loan Meme charges on borrows, repayments, and lending deposits and withdrawals, in USD at the time they are charged.
methodology.Revenue: All of the fees (Borrow, Repay, Deposit, Withdraw); the protocol keeps them in full.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of the fees (Borrow, Repay, Deposit, Withdraw): 77% is set aside for $LOAN buybacks at token launch and 23% goes to the treasury. No buyback has executed yet; holders revenue will be reported once they do.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest paid to lenders

Fees.Protocol Fees: Fees charged on borrows, repayments, and lending deposits and withdrawals.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: Fees charged on borrows, repayments, and lending deposits and withdrawals.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Buyback Reserve: 77% of the fees, set aside for $LOAN buybacks at token launch.
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: 23% of the fees, kept by the protocol treasury.

methodology.Fees: Carriers pay XNET for mobile data offloaded onto WiFi. Until settlement arrives, Fees are conservatively accrued from measured daily offload. Closed unsettled months use XNET's official monthly projection and newer days use a conservative API-GB rate. Carrier payments typically settle about two months later, and historical accrual is reconciled to the amount actually paid.
methodology.Revenue: Carrier WiFi offload Fees retained within XNET after payments to operators that elect fiat compensation under XIP-13.1.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Passed XIP-13.1 lets designated operators choose fiat instead of token distributions. Their 75% operator cash share is Supply-Side Revenue and is attributed to the service month reconciled by the carrier settlement that funds the payout, preserving the observed NET60+ settlement cadence.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Accrued service-period tokenholder allocation. Historically 80% of ordinary carrier Fees accrued to buyback-and-burn; under passed XIP-12, 60% does. The XIP-13.1 fiat slice contributes its 5% facilitation/BBB allocation. Values are provisional wherever the underlying Fees are provisional and reconcile with settlement. This is accrual attribution; actual on-chain buyback or burn execution can occur later.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Historically 20% of ordinary carrier Fees was allocated to operations. Under passed XIP-12, Protocol Revenue is 40%: 20% operations and 20% protocol-owned liquidity. For the XIP-13.1 fiat slice, 20% is retained for XNET operations.

Fees.Carrier WiFi Offload Fees: Gross carrier WiFi offload service Fees. Daily values are shaped by network offload, use official monthly projections when available, and are reconciled to actual carrier settlement.

Revenue.Carrier WiFi Offload Fees Retained: Carrier WiFi offload Fees retained within XNET after subtracting XIP-13.1 fiat-operator payouts.

SupplySideRevenue.Carrier WiFi Offload Fees To Fiat Deploy: Fiat compensation to designated operators under passed XIP-13.1. The operator cash share is 75% of that operator's gross fiat service allocation.

HoldersRevenue.Accrued Buyback & Burn Allocation: Service-period buyback-and-burn allocation for ordinary carrier Fees: historically 80%, and 60% under passed XIP-12. It follows the same provisional-and-reconciled accrual basis as Fees.
HoldersRevenue.Fiat Facilitation BBB Allocation: XIP-13.1 facilitation/BBB allocation equal to 5% of the fiat operator's gross service allocation.

ProtocolRevenue.Operations: Operations allocation: 20% of ordinary carrier Fees, plus the 20% operations portion of any XIP-13.1 fiat-operator service allocation.
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol-owned liquidity: Under passed XIP-12, 20% of ordinary carrier Fees is allocated to protocol-owned liquidity.

methodology.Fees: Builder fees received by crotrade from trades on Polymarket v2
methodology.Revenue: Builder fees received by crotrade from trades on Polymarket v2
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: No builder fees are kept by crotrade
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Builder fees received by crotrade, all distributed to its token holders

HoldersRevenue.Polymarket Builder Fees: Builder fees received by crotrade, all distributed to its token holders

methodology.Volume: Spot trades routed through cro.trade on Cronos (DEX swaps, launchpad bonding-curve trades and Cronos Launch trade accounts), counted once per trade at full notional, derived from the fixed 0.9% cro.trade fee each trade pays on-chain.
methodology.Fees: The 0.9% fee cro.trade charges on every spot trade routed through its contracts on Cronos.
methodology.UserFees: The 0.9% fee cro.trade charges on every spot trade routed through its contracts on Cronos.
methodology.Revenue: All trading fees are kept by cro.trade (no share goes to liquidity providers). Spot referral payouts are made off-chain from another venue and are not deducted.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: No trading fees are kept by the protocol: they all go to CRONUS holders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All trading fees. Until 2026-09-22 they went to the fee wallet, which bought CRONUS and distributed 100% of it to holders through the revenue share contract; since then they go to the CronusBurner contract, which buys CRONUS on the market and burns it.

Fees.Trading Fees: The 0.9% fee on each spot trade routed by cro.trade, taken in CRO or in the input token.

UserFees.Trading Fees: The 0.9% fee on each spot trade routed by cro.trade, taken in CRO or in the input token.

Revenue.Trading Fees To CRONUS Revenue Share: Trading fees sent to the fee wallet and distributed 100% to CRONUS holders as revenue share (until 2026-09-22).
Revenue.Trading Fees To CRONUS Buyback And Burn: Trading fees sent to the CronusBurner contract to buy back and burn CRONUS (since 2026-09-22).

HoldersRevenue.CRONUS Holders Revenue Share: Trading fees used to buy CRONUS and distribute 100% of it to holders through the revenue share contract (until 2026-09-22).
HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Trading fees sent to the CronusBurner contract, which buys CRONUS and burns it (since 2026-09-22).

methodology.Fees: Actual quote-asset swap charges emitted by the verified TaxHook FeesAccrued event. V1 launches charge no trading tax. No token mint allocation, gas, deposits, claim payments or buyback execution is counted as a new fee.
methodology.Revenue: Treasury allocation of each fee on an accrual basis; excludes creators, referrers and launched-token buybacks.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The same treasury allocation as Revenue. Fledgo has no own-token holder revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator recipients, attributed referrers and launched-token buyback allocations. Missing referrers retain their allocation for creators. Buybacks benefit the launched token, not a Fledgo governance token.

Fees.Trading fees: Exact totalFee in FeesAccrued, denominated in that registered pool configuration quote asset. Native ETH and native Arc USDC are 18-decimal raw amounts; ERC-20 quotes retain their own decimals. USD totals depend on DefiLlama historical price coverage.

Revenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to creator recipients: Per-swap gross quote times immutable creatorBps, minus buyback allocation and referral allocation only when the event names a nonzero referrer.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to referrers: Per-swap gross quote times referralBps floored, only for an authenticated nonzero FeesAccrued referrer. Later claims are excluded.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to launched-token buybacks: Per-swap gross quote times buybackBps floored; later buybacks and burns settle this allocation and are not new fees or protocol-holder revenue.

methodology.BridgeVolume: Volume of completed cross-chain transfers routed through LilSwap, counted on the source chain.
methodology.Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.UserFees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

Fees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

Revenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees To Partners: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

methodology.Fees: Yield from RealFi's reserve portfolio (treasury bills, money market funds, CLO ETFs, floating-rate bonds and private credit), counted when it is minted on-chain as new USDrf at each weekly staking epoch, net of portfolio losses burned from the sUSDrf staking vault. Excludes income RealFi earns off-chain on unstaked USDrf reserves that is never minted on-chain. Mint and redeem fees are currently 0 bps.
methodology.Revenue: Share of each epoch's minted yield sent to the RealFi protocol fee address instead of the sUSDrf staking vault.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of each epoch's minted yield sent to the RealFi protocol fee address instead of the sUSDrf staking vault.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of each epoch's minted yield added to the sUSDrf staking vault, which raises the USDrf redeemable per sUSDrf, net of portfolio losses burned from the vault.

Fees.Assets Yields: Reserve portfolio yield minted as new USDrf at each weekly staking epoch, net of losses burned from the sUSDrf staking vault.

Revenue.Assets Yields To Protocol: Part of the minted yield sent to the RealFi protocol fee address.

ProtocolRevenue.Assets Yields To Protocol: Part of the minted yield sent to the RealFi protocol fee address.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields To sUSDrf Stakers: Part of the minted yield added to the sUSDrf staking vault, net of losses burned from the vault.

methodology.Fees: ZC burned by users to publish in the Book, relay fees on private posts, payments and withdrawals, and deposit vetting fees of the ZC privacy pool. The launcher share of Stockereum's swap fee on ZC trades is a token tax and is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: All fees: burns accrue to holders, the rest to the protocol; no supply-side payments except relay fees earned by third-party relayers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Relay fees earned by the team-run relayer and deposit vetting fees kept by the Entrypoint.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ZC permanently burned by users to post.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Relay fees on zipcoin Entrypoint withdrawals submitted by relayers other than the team's.

Fees.Burn-to-Post Fees: ZC sent to the burn address by users to publish a word via ZipBroadcaster, ZipDoorstep or ZipHearth (which buys ZC with ETH and burns it). Public burns from the team's own wallets are excluded.
Fees.Relay Fees: Basis-point fee on the withdrawn value paid to the relayer that submits a private post, payment, swap or withdrawal, in the note's asset (ZC, ETH, DAI, USDC or USDT).
Fees.Deposit Vetting Fees: Fee the zipcoin Entrypoint deducts from each deposit into the ZC privacy pool (assetConfig.vettingFeeBPS).

Revenue.Relay Fees: Relay fees earned by the team-run relayer.
Revenue.Deposit Vetting Fees: Vetting fees kept by the Entrypoint, withdrawable by its owner.

ProtocolRevenue.Relay Fees: Relay fees earned by the team-run relayer.
ProtocolRevenue.Deposit Vetting Fees: Vetting fees kept by the Entrypoint, withdrawable by its owner.

HoldersRevenue.Burn-to-Post Fees: ZC permanently removed from supply when users post.

SupplySideRevenue.Relay Fees: Relay fees on zipcoin Entrypoint withdrawals submitted by third-party relayers.

methodology.Volume: Stablecoin amount of every completed P2P trade, read from the VailoxEscrow EscrowComplete events. Each trade is counted once (the off-chain fiat leg is not added) and cancelled or refunded trades are excluded.
methodology.Fees: Escrow fees paid by sellers and buyers on completed P2P trades, read from EscrowComplete events. Fees are tiered by trade size (fixed fee below 50 USD, then 1.25% down to 0.25%) with a lower rate for verified merchants. Cancelled or refunded trades pay no fee.
methodology.UserFees: All escrow fees are paid directly by the trading users.
methodology.Revenue: All escrow fees are kept by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All escrow fees go to the protocol treasury.

Fees.Seller Escrow Fees: Fee paid by the seller on top of the escrowed amount, charged when the trade completes.
Fees.Buyer Escrow Fees: Fee deducted from the amount the buyer receives when the trade completes.

UserFees.Seller Escrow Fees: Fee paid by the seller on top of the escrowed amount, charged when the trade completes.
UserFees.Buyer Escrow Fees: Fee deducted from the amount the buyer receives when the trade completes.

Revenue.Seller Escrow Fees To Protocol: Seller escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.
Revenue.Buyer Escrow Fees To Protocol: Buyer escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.

ProtocolRevenue.Seller Escrow Fees To Protocol: Seller escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.
ProtocolRevenue.Buyer Escrow Fees To Protocol: Buyer escrow fees credited to the protocol on completion.

methodology.Fees: Everything PeddleQuest charges: the fee quest creators pay on top of the reward pool they deposit, the flat quest creation fee, the protocol's share of rewards that winners did not claim before the deadline, payments for trending and banner promotion slots, and the fee users pay to mint an optional completion badge.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: all of it is paid by quest creators, advertisers and badge minters. Joining a quest and claiming a reward are free.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) are kept by the protocol. Quest rewards themselves go to winners and are not counted as fees or revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) accrued to the protocol treasury (a Safe multisig).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of badge mint fees routed on-chain to buyback and burn. Zero while that route is switched off, which it has been since launch.

Fees.Reward Pool Deposit Fees: Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
Fees.Quest Creation Fees: Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
Fees.Unclaimed Rewards Share: The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
Fees.Promotion Slot Fees: Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
Fees.Badge Mint Fees: Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

UserFees.Reward Pool Deposit Fees: Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
UserFees.Quest Creation Fees: Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
UserFees.Unclaimed Rewards Share: The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
UserFees.Promotion Slot Fees: Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
UserFees.Badge Mint Fees: Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

Revenue.Reward Pool Deposit Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
Revenue.Quest Creation Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
Revenue.Unclaimed Rewards Share To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
Revenue.Promotion Slot Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
Revenue.Badge Mint Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.
Revenue.Badge Mint Fees To Buyback And Burn: The share of badge mint fees the on-chain fee router sends to its buyback-and-burn address. Zero while that route is switched off.

ProtocolRevenue.Reward Pool Deposit Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
ProtocolRevenue.Quest Creation Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
ProtocolRevenue.Unclaimed Rewards Share To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
ProtocolRevenue.Promotion Slot Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
ProtocolRevenue.Badge Mint Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

HoldersRevenue.Badge Mint Fees To Buyback And Burn: The share of badge mint fees the on-chain fee router sends to its buyback-and-burn address. Zero while that route is switched off.

methodology.Fees: Copy trading fees fomo-mcp users pay on every copied buy and sell (1% on copies under $100, 0.5% from $100), plus the creator fees of the fomo-mcp token $FOMOMCP on the Pons launchpad.
methodology.UserFees: Copy trading fees paid by fomo-mcp users. Excludes the $FOMOMCP creator fees, which are paid by $FOMOMCP traders.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (copy trading fees and $FOMOMCP creator fees) are kept by fomo-mcp.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees (copy trading fees and $FOMOMCP creator fees) are kept by fomo-mcp.

Fees.Trading Fees: Copy trading fees on Solana, taken by Jupiter as a referral fee and received in fomo-mcp's Jupiter referral account (the 80% that reaches the account; Jupiter keeps 20%).
Fees.Creator Fees: ETH that Pons credits to the $FOMOMCP creator fee recipient in its fee escrow: the 2% creator tax and 70% of the 1% curve fee on the launch curve, then the creator share of the Pons hook fees on the Uniswap v4 pool after graduation. Counted when Pons sweeps and credits them.

UserFees.Trading Fees: Same as the Fees component.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Same as the Fees component.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Same as the Fees component.

methodology.Volume: Native-token notional of launchpad bonding-curve buys and sells, before the token graduates to an orderbook or AMM market.
methodology.Fees: Bonding-curve fee paid in the native token on every launchpad buy and sell.
methodology.UserFees: Bonding-curve fee paid in the native token on every launchpad buy and sell.
methodology.Revenue: Launchpad fee kept by Crystal after the token creator's split.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Launchpad fee kept by Crystal after the token creator's split.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Launchpad fee paid to the token creator.

Fees.Bonding Curve Fees: Native-token fee taken on each launchpad buy and sell.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Fees: Native-token fee taken on each launchpad buy and sell.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Protocol: Launchpad fee routed to the Crystal governance address.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Creators: Launchpad fee paid to the token creator.

methodology.Fees: USDW trading fees accrued to the protocol, measured as the increase in FeeRouter.totalPlatformFees() on each chain where Wager Predict is deployed.
methodology.Revenue: The same increase in FeeRouter.totalPlatformFees(). That counter is the platform's collected trading fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The increase in FeeRouter.totalPlatformFees() kept by the protocol.

Fees.Trading Fees: USDW added to FeeRouter.totalPlatformFees() during the period.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: USDW added to FeeRouter.totalPlatformFees() during the period.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: USDW added to FeeRouter.totalPlatformFees() during the period.

methodology.Fees: Fees charged on bets in every V5 room: the room stakers' fee, the platform fee and the room creator's fee.
methodology.Revenue: The platform fee, sent to the ElcasTreasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The ElcasTreasury swaps the platform fee to $ELCAS and burns it.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The fee kept by each room's pool for its stakers and the fee paid to each room's creator.

Fees.Bet Fees: Fees charged on each bet: the room stakers' fee, the platform fee and the room creator's fee.

Revenue.Platform Fees To ELCAS Buyback And Burn: Platform fee sent to the ElcasTreasury, which buys and burns $ELCAS.

HoldersRevenue.Platform Fees To ELCAS Buyback And Burn: Platform fee sent to the ElcasTreasury, which buys and burns $ELCAS.

SupplySideRevenue.Bet Fees To Room Stakers: Fee kept by the room's pool, owned by its stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Room Creators: Fee paid to the room's creator.

methodology.UserFees: Open and close fees and borrow paid by traders.
methodology.Fees: Open and close fees (a share of the position size, set per market) and hourly borrow paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of open and close fees (currently 10 %), accrued for the platform's fee address.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of open and close fees, accrued for the platform's fee address.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the open and close fees and all borrow go to each market's LP vault; the market's creator takes up to 20 % of the open and close fees.
methodology.Volume: Notional of positions opened plus notional closed (full and partial closes, take profit / stop loss), across every margin token's book.
methodology.OpenInterest: Long and short position size open in every market at the end of the period.

Fees.Open Fees: Fee charged when a position opens.
Fees.Close Fees: Fee charged when a position closes, fully, partially or through its take profit / stop loss.
Fees.Borrow Fees: Hourly borrow on the position size, paid when it closes.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of open and close fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of open and close fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's share of open and close fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To LP Vaults: The rest of the open and close fees, kept by the market's LP vault.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Fees To LP Vaults: Borrow, kept by the market's LP vault.

methodology.Fees: The fee taken from each settled round's losing side (set per market, up to 6 %).
methodology.UserFees: The fee taken from each settled round's losing side.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of each round's fee (currently 1 % of the losing side).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of each round's fee, accrued for the platform's fee address.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The market's house vault LPs, the market's creator and whoever settles the round (bounty).

Fees.Round Fees: The fee taken from each settled round's losing side.

Revenue.Round Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of the round fee.

ProtocolRevenue.Round Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of the round fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's share of the round fee (up to 2 % of the losing side).
SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To House Vaults: The rest of the round fee, kept by the market's house vault.
SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To Settlers: The settle bounty paid to whoever settles the round (up to 1 % of the losing side).

methodology.Fees: Fees paid on room-key buys and sells, the flat fee to launch a room token, and swap fees earned by room-token liquidity. Excludes fees on Spot swaps routed through third-party aggregators.
methodology.Revenue: AlfaClub's platform key-trading fee, room-token launch fees and 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator shares in AlfaClub's own room, the room behind the ALFA token.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: AlfaClub's platform key-trading fee, room-token launch fees and 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator shares in AlfaClub's own room, the room behind the ALFA token.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator key-trading fees, plus 85% of room-token swap fees: 50% to the room's keyholders and 35% to the creator. Creator shares in AlfaClub's own room count as Revenue instead.

Fees.Key Trading Fees: Platform and creator fees on room-key buys and sells, charged on top of the key price (currently 2% + 2%, unchanged since launch).
Fees.Token Launch Fees: Flat USDG fee paid to AlfaClub when a room token launches; AlfaClub pays the launch gas.
Fees.Token Swap Fees: 1% Uniswap V3 LP fee earned by each room token's locked liquidity, counted in USDG when collected; token-side fees are sold for USDG first.

Revenue.Key Trading Fees To Protocol: Platform share of room-key trading fees, plus the creator share in AlfaClub's own room.
Revenue.Token Launch Fees To Protocol: Room-token launch fees, kept by the platform.
Revenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator's credited share of the ALFA pool (its 35% less any part committed to permanent liquidity), since AlfaClub created that room.

ProtocolRevenue.Key Trading Fees To Protocol: Platform share of room-key trading fees, plus the creator share in AlfaClub's own room.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Launch Fees To Protocol: Room-token launch fees, kept by the platform.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator's credited share of the ALFA pool (its 35% less any part committed to permanent liquidity), since AlfaClub created that room.

SupplySideRevenue.Key Trading Fees To Creators: Creator share of room-key trading fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Keyholders: 50% of room-token swap fees, claimable by the room's keyholders.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Creators: The creator's 35% of room-token swap fees, less any part committed to permanent liquidity.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Permanent Liquidity: The part of the creator's 35% that the creator committed at launch to permanent liquidity for the room token.

methodology.Fees: Pons creator fees paid to Mosh bundles (each bundle's swarm contract), plus the one-time raise fee Mosh takes when a bundle launches. The creator fees are also counted by Pons V2 as its creators' share, so this adapter is marked as double counted.
methodology.Revenue: Mosh's share of the creator fees (creatorFeeShareBps, 20% at launch), the raise fee (raiseFeeBps, 5% of the filled raise), and, where the Mosh treasury holds a bundle's fee claims itself, its pro-rata part of the backers' share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Mosh's share of the creator fees (creatorFeeShareBps, 20% at launch), the raise fee (raiseFeeBps, 5% of the filled raise), and, where the Mosh treasury holds a bundle's fee claims itself, its pro-rata part of the backers' share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The bundle backers' share of the creator fees (80% at launch), including any team share a bundle's creator set out of it, less the part the Mosh treasury holds as a backer.

Fees.Pons creator fees routed to bundles: The creator share of Pons trading fees on a bundle's token, received by its swarm contract (FeesSynced.received).
Fees.Bundle raise fees: The one-time fee on a bundle's filled raise (5%), paid to the Mosh treasury in the launch transaction. The part of a raise the treasury funded itself is excluded, since that fee is the treasury paying itself.

Revenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury: Mosh's share of the creator fees, paid to its treasury at each sync (FeesSynced.toTreasury).
Revenue.Bundle raise fees: The raise fee, all of it Mosh's.
Revenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury as a bundl: The part of the backers' share credited to the Mosh treasury's own fee claims, in proportion to its claim over all claims at each sync ($BUN: all of it).

ProtocolRevenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury: Mosh's share of the creator fees, paid to its treasury at each sync (FeesSynced.toTreasury).
ProtocolRevenue.Bundle raise fees: The raise fee, all of it Mosh's.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury as a bundl: The part of the backers' share credited to the Mosh treasury's own fee claims, in proportion to its claim over all claims at each sync ($BUN: all of it).

SupplySideRevenue.Creator fees to bundle backers: The backers' share of the creator fees, credited to their claims at each sync (FeesSynced.toContributors), less the treasury's part as a backer.

methodology.Fees: 2% fee on realized PnL at close, 2% fee on margin lost in liquidations, and LP profits above the $5M cap swept to PAPER stakers. Trader wins and losses that stay in the LP are not counted.
methodology.Revenue: All fees: half of the 2% fees to PAPER stakers, half to the dev fee recipient, and LP profits above the $5M cap to PAPER stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of the 2% close and liquidation fees, paid to the dev fee recipient.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of the 2% close and liquidation fees plus LP profits above the $5M cap, paid in USDC to PAPER stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Trading Fees: 2% of realized PnL on closed positions.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: 2% of margin lost on liquidated positions.
Fees.LP Surplus: LP profits above the $5M cap, swept to PAPER stakers.

Revenue.Distributions To PAPER Stakers: Half of the 2% fees plus LP profits above the $5M cap.

HoldersRevenue.Distributions To PAPER Stakers: Half of the 2% fees plus LP profits above the $5M cap.

methodology.Volume: Notional volume of Hyperliquid perpetual trades (including HIP-3 markets) placed through Auspex.
methodology.Fees: Hyperliquid builder code fees paid by users on trades placed through Auspex; excludes Hyperliquid's own trading fees.
methodology.Revenue: Builder code fees collected by Auspex. Referral rewards Auspex later pays out from its treasury are not deducted.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Builder code fees collected by Auspex. Referral rewards Auspex later pays out from its treasury are not deducted.

Fees.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid trades.

Revenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

ProtocolRevenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

methodology.UserFees: Open and close fees and borrow paid by traders.
methodology.Fees: Open and close fees (a share of the position size, set per market) and hourly borrow paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of open and close fees (currently 10 %), collected in the protocol's FeeVault.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of open and close fees, collected in the protocol's FeeVault.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the open and close fees and all borrow go to each market's LP vault; the market's creator takes up to 20 % of the open and close fees.
methodology.Volume: Notional of positions opened plus notional closed (full and partial closes, take profit / stop loss), across every margin token's book.
methodology.OpenInterest: Long and short position size open in every market at the end of the period.

Fees.Open Fees: Fee charged when a position opens.
Fees.Close Fees: Fee charged when a position closes, fully, partially or through its take profit / stop loss.
Fees.Borrow Fees: Hourly borrow on the position size, paid when it closes.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of open and close fees, sent to the FeeVault.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The protocol's share of open and close fees, sent to the FeeVault.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's share of open and close fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To LP Vaults: The rest of the open and close fees, kept by the market's LP vault.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Fees To LP Vaults: Borrow, kept by the market's LP vault.

methodology.UserFees: All swap fees are paid by the swapper.
methodology.Fees: Swap fee charged on the output token of each swap (protocol share plus LP share), read from the Swapped event. The coverage toll a swap may pay when it drains a leg below its coverage floor stays in the leg's reserves as a buffer and is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol share (protoFee) of the swap fee. Zero on coop fills, which book no protocol fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol share (protoFee) of the swap fee goes to the BTR treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LP share (lpFee) of the swap fee, accrued to the liquidity providers of the output leg.
methodology.Volume: Input-token amount (amountIn) of every swap on BTR pools, read from the pool Swapped event and counted once per swap. Includes the protocol's own coop-arbitrage fills (CoopArb): they are real pool swaps that pay an LP fee, and while they were the only flow the series read zero.

Fees.Swap Fees: Swap fee charged on the output token of each swap (protocol share plus LP share).

UserFees.Swap Fees: Swap fee charged on the output token of each swap (protocol share plus LP share).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol share (protoFee) of the swap fee.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol share (protoFee) of the swap fee, sent to the BTR treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: LP share (lpFee) of the swap fee, accrued to the output leg's liquidity providers.

methodology.Fees: SOL service fees paid by users to Tsunammi for the Create Token flow.
methodology.Revenue: All tracked Create Token service fees are retained as Tsunammi protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: SOL received by Tsunammi's dedicated Create Token fee collector.

Fees.Create Token Service Fees: SOL received by Tsunammi's public Create Token service-fee collector from external addresses.

Revenue.Create Token Service Fees: Create Token service fees retained by Tsunammi.

ProtocolRevenue.Create Token Service Fees: Create Token service fees retained by Tsunammi's protocol treasury.

methodology.Volume: The USDC side of every swap on the bonding curves of tokens launched with Ryntra Launch (Meteora DBC pools on its configs, created by its pool payer), from the swap events. Trading after a token graduates is Meteora DAMM v2's volume and is not counted. Double counted: Meteora already lists this volume.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on the bonding curves of tokens launched with Ryntra Launch (Meteora DBC pools on its configs, created by its pool payer), including the 20% Meteora keeps; after graduation, the referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra on trades made through Ryntra; and what Ryntra takes as the partner of a graduated curve (its share of the migration fee, and later the fees of the DAMM v2 liquidity locked for it) when its fee claimer withdraws them. The creator's share of the migration fee and the quote above the graduation threshold (not a fee) are not included.
methodology.UserFees: What traders pay: the bonding curve fee, the referral fee Ryntra earns on graduated-pool trades and the graduated pool's fees; not the migration fee, which comes out of the curve's reserve.
methodology.Revenue: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' share of the bonding curve fee, the referral fees Meteora pays it, and its graduation income when withdrawn.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' share of the bonding curve fee, the referral fees Meteora pays it and its graduation income, all of it for the protocol: Ryntra has no token and distributes nothing to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The token creator's 40% of the configs' share of the bonding curve fee, Meteora's protocol fee, and the referral fees Meteora pays other apps.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The whole fee traders pay on every swap on the bonding curve of a token launched with Ryntra. It starts at 50% (protected config) or 20% (classic, micro) at launch to deter snipers and decays to 1% within minutes, plus a volatility fee. 80% goes to the configs (40% of it to the creator, 60% to Ryntra) and 20% to Meteora, which pays the referral fee out of its part.
Fees.Graduated Pool Referral Fees: The referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra, out of its protocol fee, on trades made through Ryntra in the pool a launch graduated into.
Fees.Graduation Fees: Ryntra's share of a graduating curve's migration fee — 60% of 2% on Classic and Protected, all of 8% on Micro — when withdrawn by its claimer (the vault, or on Micro Ryntra's launch executor).
Fees.Graduated Pool Fees: Fees of the DAMM v2 liquidity locked for Ryntra after a launch graduates, when claimed, in USDC and in the launched token.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The whole fee traders pay on the bonding curve.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Referral Fees: The referral fee, part of the fee traders pay Meteora in the graduated pool.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Fees: Fees traders pay to the DAMM v2 liquidity locked for Ryntra, when claimed.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Ryntra: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' 80% of the bonding curve fee.
Revenue.Referral Fees To Ryntra: The referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra on trades made through it, on the curve and in the graduated pool.
Revenue.Graduated Pool Fees To Ryntra: Claimed fees of the liquidity locked for Ryntra after graduation.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Ryntra: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' 80% of the bonding curve fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Referral Fees To Ryntra: The referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra on trades made through it, on the curve and in the graduated pool.
ProtocolRevenue.Graduated Pool Fees To Ryntra: Claimed fees of the liquidity locked for Ryntra after graduation.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: The token creator's 40% of the configs' 80% of the bonding curve fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Meteora: Meteora's protocol fee: its 20% of the bonding curve fee, less the referral fee it pays.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees To Other Apps: The referral fee Meteora pays other apps on curve trades made through them.

methodology.Volume: One side of every trade made through Ryntra. On Solana, from the trader's own token movements in the trade: the stablecoin they paid or received, else the SOL, else the token they paid — gross of Ryntra's fee (a fee taken from what they received is added back). On Arc, from the swap's own events: the side in USDC, EURC, WETH or cirBTC of a KyberSwap swap, gross of the router's fees (the amount the fee was taken from), and the input a trader sent Circle's swap Adapter. A trade is Ryntra's when it paid Ryntra's fee inside it. Trades on the bonding curve of a token launched with Ryntra are counted under Ryntra Launch. Double counted: the venues the trades are routed through already list this volume.
methodology.Fees: Fees people pay Ryntra on trades made through it. On Solana: what the swap router (Jupiter, or DFlow when Jupiter routes through it) pays into Ryntra's fee wallet and its Jupiter referral account inside the trade. On Arc: the developer fee of a Circle swap and the fee leg of a KyberSwap swap that name Ryntra's fee address, read from Circle's fee collector and KyberSwap's router events. Plain transfers into these accounts are not fees.
methodology.UserFees: Fees traders pay Ryntra inside the trades they make through it.
methodology.Revenue: Trading fees kept by Ryntra: the whole fee paid into its fee wallet on Solana and from KyberSwap on Arc, what reached its Jupiter referral account less Jupiter's 20% share, and the Circle developer fee less the share (about 10%) Circle's fee collector routes to its protocol recipient. Cashback and invite rewards are paid later, when people claim them, and are not deducted.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Trading fees kept by Ryntra, all of it for the protocol: Ryntra has no token and distributes nothing to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Jupiter's 20% share of the fees that reached Ryntra's Jupiter referral account, and the share (about 10%) of the Circle developer fee that Circle's fee collector routes to its protocol recipient on Arc.

Fees.Trading Fees: Ryntra's fee on swaps and spot trades, paid into its fee wallet or its Jupiter referral account on Solana, or to its fee address on Arc, inside the trade.

UserFees.Trading Fees: Ryntra's fee on swaps and spot trades, paid by the trader inside the trade.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Ryntra: The whole fee paid into the fee wallet and from KyberSwap, 80% of what reached the Jupiter referral account, and what the Circle developer fee leaves Ryntra after the protocol share (about 90%).

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Ryntra: The whole fee paid into the fee wallet and from KyberSwap, 80% of what reached the Jupiter referral account, and what the Circle developer fee leaves Ryntra after the protocol share (about 90%).

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Jupiter: Jupiter's 20% share of the fees that reached Ryntra's Jupiter referral account.
SupplySideRevenue.Developer Fee Protocol Share: The share (about 10%) of the developer fee on a Circle swap that Circle's fee collector routes to its protocol recipient on Arc, read from the collector's event.

methodology.Volume: Total stake matched each day, read from the SX Bet V3 escrow's fill events. Every bet is funded by both sides, so both stakes are counted.
methodology.Fees: Commission SX Bet takes on the profit of winning bets, counted when the escrow pays it to SX's fee wallet at settlement. On V3 the rates are set per account and can apply to singles as well as parlays; losing and voided bets pay nothing.
methodology.Revenue: Commission taken from the profit of winning bets and kept by SX. Market makers get none of it.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All commission goes to SX: first a fee wallet, and from 4 September 2026 the treasury contract that also holds the SX community fund.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Zero. Market makers get no share of the commission.

Fees.Trading Fees: Commission taken from the profit of winning bets when the V3 escrow pays SX's fee wallet at settlement.

Revenue.Trading Commission To Protocol: Commission taken from the profit of winning bets and kept by SX. Market makers get none of it.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Commission To Protocol: All commission sent to SX: a fee wallet until 4 September 2026, then the treasury contract that also holds the SX community fund.

methodology.Volume: SOL paid by buyers and SOL paid out to sellers on the bonding curves, before fees.
methodology.Fees: Everything charged on the launchpad: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%), the reward fee a token's creator chose at launch (0% to 5% of each trade), the fee to launch a token ($2, paid in SOL) and the migration fee taken from the SOL a curve raised when its token graduates (1%, less the network rent of the new pool's accounts).
methodology.Revenue: DEEP's share: its 1.25% fee on bonding-curve trades, the token launch fees and the migration fees. Reward fees are not included.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DEEP's 1.25% fee on bonding-curve trades, the token launch fees and the migration fees, all paid into DEEP's on-chain fee vault, which pays 10% to the team that builds DEEP and 90% to the DEEP treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The reward fee of each token, paid in full to the token's creator or, for a Holder Rewards token, to the holders of that token.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%).

methodology.Volume: The quote-token side (SOL on a TOKEN/SOL pool) of every swap, before fees.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury share of each fulfilled inference fee plus forfeited dispute bonds.

ProtocolRevenue.Inference Fees To Treasury: Protocol share (protocolFeeBps) of each fulfilled fee, accruing to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Dispute Bond Forfeitures: Bonds forfeited by losing challengers, accruing to the treasury.

methodology.Volume: USDC players spend opening Raflux gacha packs of physical trading cards (Super Gacha on Solana, FluxBox on Base), at the full pack price including any part covered by a coupon. Packs are sold at fixed prices of 10, 25, 50 and 100 USDC (1 USDC packs on Base at launch); each pack pulls a physical card, often with a USDC bonus, that the player can ship home or sell back for USDC.
methodology.Fees: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments. This is the 10% fee Raflux keeps when a card is exchanged for USDC plus the game result of pulls, so it is negative on days when players win more than they pay.
methodology.Revenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, kept by Raflux. No share goes to LPs, referrers or token holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, all of it sent to the Raflux treasury.

Fees.Buybacks: USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments.

Revenue.Buybacks: USDC returned to players, subtracted from revenue kept by Raflux.

ProtocolRevenue.Buybacks: USDC returned to players, subtracted from treasury revenue.

Revenue.Fees To Admin Vault: 10% of launched token fees and taxes, sent to adminVault.
Revenue.Fees To PUMPER Buy And Burn Vault: 5% of launched token fees and taxes, sent to the PUMPER buy-and-burn vault.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Creators And Token Stakers: 80% of launched token fees and taxes, split between creator, stakers, buyback-and-burn and liquidity per the creator's fixed split.
SupplySideRevenue.PUMPER Swap Fees To LPs: 100% of PUMPER pool fees, paid to its liquidity providers.

methodology.UserFees: Service fees and Polymarket builder fees, both paid by the trader on every Polymarket buy and sell routed through Polycool.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral rewards: referrers earn 25% of the service fees generated by the users they referred. methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Service fees and Polymarket builder fees kept by Polycool after referral rewards are paid out.

Fees.Service fees: Incoming pUSD and USDC.e `Transfer` events to the Polycool treasury `0x5cd4d6c28efc65028afa307712976f97ea87615c` on Polygon, each one a service fee pulled from a trader's wallet.
Fees.Polymarket builder fees: Builder fees of the trades attributed to Polycool's Polymarket builder code, from the CLOB builder-trades API. The trader pays them inside Polymarket's trade fee; Polymarket pays them out daily in pUSD to Polycool's builder wallet.

UserFees.Service fees: Service fees pulled from the trader's wallet into the Polycool treasury.
UserFees.Polymarket builder fees: Builder fees paid by the trader inside Polymarket's trade fee on trades attributed to Polycool's builder code.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards: Outgoing pUSD `Transfer` events from the referral payout wallet `0x7537611f943272f53dbecabf5dcdd6a55ba7286e` on Polygon, each one a referral claim paid to a referrer (25% of the service fees of the users they referred).

Revenue.Service fees: Service fees received by the Polycool treasury, minus referral rewards paid out in the same period. Referral rewards accrue on service fees only, so they are netted against this row; it can be negative in a period with a large claim and few trades.
Revenue.Polymarket builder fees: Polymarket builder fees, kept in full by Polycool: no share of them goes to referrers.

ProtocolRevenue.Service fees: Service fees received by the Polycool treasury, minus referral rewards paid out in the same period, all kept by Polycool.
ProtocolRevenue.Polymarket builder fees: Polymarket builder fees paid out to Polycool's builder wallet, all kept by Polycool.

methodology.Revenue: The platform fee and the harvested locked-liquidity fees, both received by the launchpad treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 0.25% platform fee on bonding-curve trades and the harvested locked-liquidity fees, all sent to the launchpad treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator fee of each bonding-curve trade, paid to the wallet that launched the coin.

Fees.Trading Fees: 0.75% of every LaunchLab bonding curve trade on an Incognito launch (0.25% platform fee plus 0.5% creator fee), charged in the pool's quote token.
Fees.LP Fees: Quote-token fees harvested from the locked liquidity of graduated Incognito launches.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The 0.25% platform fee on bonding curve trades, kept by the launchpad.
Revenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, kept by the launchpad.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The 0.25% platform fee on bonding curve trades, sent to the launchpad treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, sent to the launchpad treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: The 0.5% creator fee on bonding curve trades, paid to the wallet that launched the coin.

methodology.UserFees: Users pay $0 for transactions. sFUEL (gas token) is obtained free from faucets and has no market value.
methodology.Fees: SKALE uses sFUEL (SKALE Fuel), a gas token distributed FREE via faucets. While transactions consume gas on-chain, sFUEL has $0 monetary value. User fees are $0.
methodology.Revenue: Network revenue comes from SKL token staking subscriptions by dApp developers, not from transaction fees. On-chain transaction fees are $0 as sFUEL is free.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol revenue is generated through SKL staking model where dApp developers stake tokens for network access. Transaction fees contribute $0 as sFUEL is valueless.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Validators/nodes are compensated through SKL staking rewards, not transaction fees. On-chain gas fees in sFUEL are $0.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No sFUEL is burned or distributed as revenue since it has no value. Revenue model is entirely based on SKL token staking.

methodology.Fees: Transaction fees paid by users on Stacks, computed by querying the Allium database.
methodology.Revenue: None. Stacks transaction fees are not burned
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Stacks transaction fees are paid to miners/block producers.

methodology.Fees: Flat $0.01 USDST charged on every STRATO transaction. Transactions paid with a Voucher credit are free and are not counted. Excludes application fees earned by the protocols running on STRATO (CDP stability fees, AMM swap fees, lending interest), which are tracked under the STRATO protocol listing.
methodology.Revenue: Share of the transaction fee kept by the chain's FeeCollector treasury. This is the whole fee today, because the block proposer share is configured at 0 basis points.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of the transaction fee paid to the block proposer's operator and its delegators through the StratoStaking contract. 0 basis points today.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of the transaction fee kept by the chain's FeeCollector treasury.

Fees.Transaction Gas Fees: Flat $0.01 USDST per non-voucher transaction, charged by FeeRouter.payFees().

Revenue.Transaction Fees To Treasury: Portion of each transaction fee transferred to the genesis FeeCollector (0x100d).

SupplySideRevenue.Transaction Fees To Validators: Portion of each transaction fee transferred to StratoStaking for the block proposer and its delegators.

ProtocolRevenue.Transaction Fees To Treasury: Portion of each transaction fee transferred to the genesis FeeCollector (0x100d).

methodology.Fees: THORChain's native L1 transaction fee (the NativeTransactionFee constant, 0.02 RUNE per native transaction), charged on native THORChain txs.
methodology.Revenue: The native transaction fee accrues entirely to the THORChain Reserve, so revenue equals fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The native transaction fee accrues entirely to the THORChain Reserve.

Fees.Network Fees: Native L1 transaction fee (0.02 RUNE/tx) paid on native THORChain transactions.

Revenue.Network Fees: Native transaction fee retained by the THORChain Reserve.

ProtocolRevenue.Network Fees: Native transaction fee retained by the THORChain Reserve.
